findings.title: harness:doctor fails on scrubbed wallets.json already on main
findings.controlFlow: npm run harness:doctor → forbids tracked wallet*.json. File is scrubbed fixture summary from OPERATOR-CONSOLE-SHELL-001 on main lineage; not introduced by Live Wiring production delta.
findings.impact: Doctor gate reports FAIL while product/security gates pass. Risk of false-blocking if treated as P0.
findings.reproduction: On tip 8a173da: npm run harness:doctor → status FAIL for wallets.json only.
findings.recommendedBoundedRepair: Narrow doctor allowlist for scrubbed operator-console fixture summaries OR rename outside wallet*.json; do not reopen M0.

findings.title: gen-offline-states.mts hardcodes absolute local implementer path as default OFFLINE_OUT
findings.controlFlow: Default out path is C:/Users/10639/AppData/Local/Temp/grok-goal-…/implementer/offline-states when OFFLINE_OUT unset. Script is offline evidence helper, not browser runtime.
findings.impact: Commits a machine-specific absolute path into production tree; violates path-scrub hygiene. No credentials. Runtime browser path unaffected. Env override works.
findings.recommendedBoundedRepair: Default to os.tmpdir()/operator-console-offline-states or require OFFLINE_OUT; never hardcode user home/temp goal paths.

findings.title: Inherited research/product docs carry trailing whitespace (git diff --check)
